name: Mistress
source:
A lady who has set up a store “VILE/VAN” in a room of an apartment building, she sells a variety of goods to clan members at reasonable prices.
Sale is also available.
[From [url=https://www.alicesoft.com/dohnadohna/chara/question/question03.html]alicesoft.com[/url]]
[spoiler]She works for the antagonist Hisamitsu as his secretary under the name Izumi (泉) - supposedly her "real" name.
